# Branch: claude/key-001-key-002

Tracking branch for KEY-001 and KEY-002 — the `file` and `command`
keystore drivers, resolving key material by keyName from a local
directory or the stdout of an operator-specified command, plus the
CORE-003 exec fallback for out-of-tree keystore drivers.

See `docs/functional-requirements.md` § KEY and `docs/status.json`.
